title: Recover a galaxy proposal after a mismatched acknowledgement
description: A developer creates one real waiting galaxy, then deliberately reuses its command UUID for a different proposal. The original remains unchanged, the proposal is retained and a fresh acknowledged command creates a distinct campaign. The fixed-catalogue harness supplies map entropy only; rules remain under review.

steps.description: Prepare a saved identity and developer access through ordinary sign-in/save UI and explicit emulator authorization. The test loader fixes catalogue entropy. Reuse one command UUID only after identity setup; actual encryption, service authorization and persistence remain active.
steps.acknowledgement: Explicit test control; not a player action or hosted-service certification.
